summary: All classifications and frozen outcomes reproduce; child-side replay/upstream runtime binding and one-seed internal proxy scope require qualifiers.
headline: All 216 classifications, frozen analysis metrics, source-cluster bootstrap results, state exports, reference invariants, component counts, costs, and outcome bindings reproduce. The audit is WARN because the child process did not execution-time re-hash the replay content or query the actual upstream checkout state, and because the evidence supports only a one-seed internal simulation/proxy engineering diagnosis.

frozen_outcome.interpretation: The zero interval is descriptive for these 24 source clusters and does not prove population equivalence. The decision applies only to this bounded leg-translation and classical positional-IK parameterization.

A_ground_truth_provenance_and_proxy_labe.finding: Endpoint goals are derived from the fixed dataset motion before generation. The replay reference is a prior simulated/model trajectory, tracking is therefore synthetic-proxy tracking, and surface slip is a collision-geometry/body-force proxy. The artifacts label these facts and do not present them as real contact-point truth or real-world ground truth.

B_normalization_and_denominators.finding: All gates use frozen absolute SI thresholds. No metric divides by a prediction's own maximum, minimum, or mean. All eight reported scalar analysis metrics have 72 finite values and zero missing/nonfinite values in each arm. The component projection divides by material speed only to form a signed projection in m/s; it is not a normalized score. Pooled slip uses total flagged support-body-frame observations over total support observations and is distinct from the equally weighted 72-case mean.

C_files_receipts_terminal_scope_counts_a.finding: All required current files exist in the authoritative result set; request/lineage/output/receipt hashes match; each log contains one successful 72-case sentinel; the actual SSH run and analyzer were observed at exit 0; and the frozen counts and outcome metrics reproduce. The warning is about certification strength: the child did not recompute request.replay_motion, the runtime source_commit was copied from configuration rather than queried from the loaded checkout, and no autonomous server parent-exit receipt exists. A later read-only check found the expected clean upstream checkout, but retrospective state is not execution-time state.

metric_reproduction.secondary_descriptive_reduction_note: All differences are retained as cross-runtime reduction roundoff. They change no support/slip count, gate, classification, frozen decision, or permitted claim.

terminal_observation.scope: external executor/write_stdin observation; explicitly not an autonomous server parent-exit receipt

D_metric_code_called.finding: The V43 launch adapter chain reaches contact_com_collect_v24, which patches the collector's metrics symbol to physics_guided_metric_v23.metrics. The collector calls that symbol for each saved case. The frozen analyzer imports the same metric and recomputes all 72 rows per arm; the component diagnostic separately reconstructs the slip counts.

E_sources_seeds_prefix_endpoints_targets.finding: The fixed V51 first construction supplies 72 ordered inputs from 24 sources with three offsets each. All selected inputs are length 120 and complete; the documented incomplete-source preservation branch was not exercised. Prefix frames 0 through 60, frame 119, goals, headings, and non-leg coordinates are unchanged. IK feet exactly match the Cartesian target and preserve segment lengths to float32 tolerance. Source-cluster bootstrap uses 24 clusters, seed 6211, and 5000 resamples. The study has one simulation seed and mixes 19 official train-derived with 5 official test-derived source clusters; pretrained exposure was not independently established. The summary ledger field name is ambiguous because it points to the current three-row append-only parent ledger, not the historical baseline-only snapshot.

F_evaluation_type.finding: The evaluation is correctly labeled as simulation-only synthetic-proxy tracking against dataset-derived fixed goals. The velocity-component report is a read-only decomposition of the frozen proxy, not an alternate score, new threshold, or new simulator experiment. It does not establish contact-point truth, causality, candidate efficacy, innovation, G1 performance, downstream training benefit, or real-world behavior.

component_diagnosis.definition: Pooled numerator is the number of supported body-frame observations whose material-point horizontal speed exceeds the frozen sliding threshold; denominator is every supported body-frame observation. Speed terms are support-weighted magnitudes. Signed projections can cancel and magnitudes are not additive.

original_document_witness.distinction: Exact float64 logged scalar norms were compared with recomputations from saved float32 reference arrays. The independent scalar contract verifies the documented float32/geometric invariants without imposing undocumented exact logged-norm equality.

continuation_document_witness.distinction: The failure demanded historical whole-ledger equality after the parent ledger had valid append-only rows. The addendum independently reconstructs the historical baseline-only snapshot and current ledger.

permitted_claim: In this one-seed internal simulation replay over 24 source clusters, neither bounded Cartesian leg translation nor the tested classical two-link positional IK changed joint-pass rate from zero; the source-cluster bootstrap for this observed slice is [0,0] percentage points. This supports stopping only the tested parameterization and records a descriptive proxy decomposition.
prohibited_inferences: population equivalence or general ineffectiveness of IK
real contact-point slip, force, torque, collision, or full-dynamics correctness
candidate efficacy, confirmed innovation, novelty, or G1 performance
downstream training benefit, deployment benefit, or real-world behavior
untouched-test generalization or absence of pretrained source exposure
action_items: Keep the claim ceiling and STOP decision limited to this parameterization and internal proxy slice.

Prospectively make the child collector recompute replay_motion and versions after loading inputs and bind the actual upstream checkout HEAD/dirty state plus model-weight hashes per batch; do not retroactively certify this run.
For any confirmatory efficacy study, preregister multiple seeds, genuinely held-out sources with pretraining-exposure accounting, and an independent or real contact evaluator.
Rename or split the future summary ledger field so the historical baseline-only snapshot and current append-only parent ledger have distinct names.
Clarify that all 72 selected inputs were complete and the incomplete-source preservation branch was not exercised.
Keep pooled component statistics separate from the per-case frozen analysis metric and label them descriptive/noncausal.
Preserve the original and continuation FAIL witnesses, their independent addenda, and the external-observation label.
